pages.title: Custom Enchantments
pages.text: $(mod_name) adds three unique enchantments:$(li2)$(thing)Reaching$() (Level 2) — Applies to $(item)Buckets$(). Extends block interaction range.$(li2)$(thing)Extending$() (Level 3) — Applies to $(item)Swords$(). Increases melee attack reach.$(li2)$(thing)Speed$() (Level 5) — Applies to $(item)Leather Boots$(). Grants a movement speed bonus.

pages.title: Weapon Special Effects
pages.text: Different weapon types have unique properties:$(li2)$(item)Daggers$() — Deal $(thing)1.5x damage$() to passive mobs. Ideal for hunting livestock.$(li2)$(item)Hammers$() — Heavy weapons that deal $(thing)1.5x damage$() to skeletons.$(li2)$(item)Silver Weapons$() — Deal $(thing)1.5x damage$() to all undead mobs. On kill, gain $(thing)5s Regeneration II$().

pages.title: Nutrition System
pages.text: $(mod_name) features a $(thing)Phytonutrient$() system that tracks nutritional variety. Eating only one type of food leads to $(important)Malnutrition$().$(br)$(bold)Key Foods:$()$(br)$(li2)$(item)Beef Soup & Vegetable Soup$() — provides dietary fiber$(li2)$(item)Chocolate$() — accumulates sugar value$(li2)$(item)Cheese$()$(li2)$(item)Salad$() — provides dietary fiber and $(item)Mashed Potato$() $(li2)$(item)Pumpkin Soup$()
Staple meals for maintaining nutrition balance.

pages.title: Crop & Farm Systems
pages.text: $(thing)Crop Disease$() — Crops can become diseased (blight) and require bone meal to cure. Use $(item)Manure$() on farmland to protect and accelerate growth; manure is periodically produced by livestock.$(li2)$(item)Onion$() — A new crop with 4 growth stages, only found in loot chests.$(li2)$(thing)Advanced Animal AI$() — Livestock have improved behavior patterns.

pages.title: Crop & Farm Systems
pages.text: $(note)In "Blight" difficulty entry, crops cannot grow; in "Extinction" difficulty entry, animals will not spawn.$()

pages.title: The Moon System
pages.text: Pay attention to the night sky! Special moon phases bring unique effects:$(li2)$(#C0392B)$(bold)Blood Moon$() — Prevents sleeping. If the gamerule is enabled, may be accompanied by more dangerous thunderstorms.$(li2)$(#3498DB)$(bold)Blue Moon$() — Rare moon phase.$(li2)$(#27AE60)$(bold)Harvest Moon$() — Crop growth benefits.$(li2)$(#D3D3D3)$(bold)New Moon$() — Binds nearby monsters, inflicting Weakness and Slowness.

pages.title: The Moon System
pages.text: $(li2)$(#F39C12)$(bold)Halo Moon$() — Special atmospheric effects.$(br2)$(note)Check the moon phase each night before making plans!$()

pages.title: Basic Difficulty Entries(Game Rules)
pages.text: Customize your experience with these gamerules:$(li2)$(thing)Crafting Time & Level$() — Enables workbench tier gating and crafting delays$(li2)$(thing)Standard Breaking Speed$() — Mining speed consistent with MITE style$(li2)$(thing)Crop Disease$() — Crops can become diseased$(li2)$(thing)Phytonutrient$() — Enables malnutrition tracking

pages.title: Advanced Difficulty Entries(Game Rules)
pages.text: More options available in the game rules when creating a world.$()$(li2)$(#C0392B)$(thing)Desolation$() — Removes all villages and pillager outposts$(li2)$(#C0392B)$(thing)Extinction$() — Animals no longer spawn$(li2)$(#C0392B)$(thing)Blight$() — Crops stop growing naturally$(li2)$(#C0392B)$(thing)Rainy Season$() — Greatly increased rain duration$(li2)$(#C0392B)$(thing)Universal Aggro$() — Piglins and Endermen attack unconditionally$(li2)$(#C0392B)$(thing)SL Punishment$() — Save/load actions cause health loss$(br2)$(important)More options available in the game rules when creating a world.$()
